# `fnox daemon start`

- **Usage:** `fnox daemon start`

Start the per-user daemon in the background

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Start the per-user daemon. Enable daemon mode in configuration or the environment for subsequent reads to use it.

```sh
fnox daemon start
fnox daemon status
```
